newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 7.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 7.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The Public Prosecutor must initiate legal proceedings if it will be proven that leaders of the farmers' organisation METESZ publicly threatened doing violence.
- The Parliament began the discussion of a draft law, which would increase the funds spent on environmental protection to sevenfold in six years.
- The Interior Ministry is preparing to set up at border-crossings and on motorways electric warners, by which the police could track the route of stolen cars.
- The police found a considerable amount of drog with young people in a discotheque on Sunday, but they cannot prove drog trading.
- Interior Minister Gabor Kuncze signed an agreement about joint fight against organised crime with Russian government officials in Moscow.
